response.sql:
WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p."fundflux", COUNT(*) AS spatial_record_count
  FROM "scanspatial" AS ss
  JOIN "projects" AS p ON p."arcregistry" = ss."arcref"
  GROUP BY p."fundflux"
), stats AS (
  SELECT "fundflux", spatial_record_count,
         SUM(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT "fundflux",
       spatial_record_count AS count,
       spatial_record_count::numeric / total_count AS share,
       spatial_record_count - average_count AS excess_over_average
FROM stats
WHERE spatial_record_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Funding sources with NULL fundflux are treated as one source group, and their matched spatial records are included in the total and average.
